scope: User-requested combined motion Kp45/45/65 Kd1 and NMPC Qzz2000, applied to shared config and evaluated only in isolated Fortress; prior39-trial history preserved.

measurement.heading_velocity: Independent time integration of truth world-position differences after yaw-only heading rotation.
measurement.height_rmse: Time-weighted piecewise-linear truth height error relative to 0.34 m.
measurement.steady_window: Last 2 s only if the full configured motion-stage duration completed without a prior controller safety fault. Each phase stores its actual requested and elapsed duration.
measurement.fault_timing: Controller log wall timestamps mapped through adjacent diagnostics arrival timestamps; this mapping is approximate. Conservative pre-fault cutoff uses earlier diagnostic stamp.
measurement.mode_lag: Kinematics mode labels reuse throttled diagnostics and may lag FAULT. Post-fault falling samples are not treated as active-support height error.
measurement.motor_log: The first motor threshold warning identifies one physics-step request; it may differ from the sample that triggers controller SafetyMonitor.
measurement.execution_effort_thresholds: Motor WARN uses 1.10 times URDF effort limits (hip/thigh26.07Nm, calf49.5Nm); no threshold excursion does not prove requests always remain below nominal limits or a calibrated real motor saturation bound.

metadata.json.note: User-requested combination of E Qzz2000 and G Kd1; shared config updated, isolated sim limits only.

limitations: Short stages and a small number of repeats cannot establish an endurance limit or safe physical-robot speed.
IMU rate, delay and friction are imposed simulation assumptions, not identified hardware models.
Simulated effort is motor-PD requested joint torque, not calibrated physical torque or foot force.
Controller-input budgets reconstructed at approximately 10 Hz can miss execution-time and physics-step peaks.

Geometric stability without a controller fault is reported separately from absence of a 1 kHz motor-request effort-threshold crossing; 500 Hz SafetyMonitor may miss a short crossing logged by the motor model.
Only fully completed movement stages receive steady velocity/height metrics; failed or unreached targets are not assigned steady performance.
Source and effective-control-input hashes must remain unchanged within each trial; compare library hashes before comparing builds.

reproducibility.raw_logs_policy: Large raw logs and generated profiles remain local in ignored log/. Report preserves numerical summaries, parameter snapshots and artifact hashes.

interpretation_zh: 每次从新仿真场景开始；前后0.50m/s、左右0.30m/s、偏航±1.5rad/s、左右0.50m/s各一次，左右0.30m/s再各复测一次。每运动段计划20s，完整运动后计划站立30s；故障或未完成不能算通过。
script_passed与geometry_and_no_controller_fault不代表无物理步请求力矩越阈。500Hz主控可能漏掉1kHz模型记录的短峰，full_acceptance进一步要求无该类记录且脚本跟踪检查通过。
26.07/49.5Nm为1.10×URDF保护判据，不是经过标定的电机连续电流饱和。effort为模拟请求力矩，不是实测电机输出或足底力。
当前参数按用户要求保留在公共配置中；测试结果不能替代真机运动验收。起身与稳定PD没有同步降低，无真机起身、行走、提交或推送。
本轮仅配置变化，没有修改控制算法或编译控制库；通过配置差异、安装symlink和实际运行参数确认生效，复用此前已通过19组CTest的同一控制库。
本轮和旧39次对比的时长及复测数量不同；不得把不同分母的通过数解释成严格统计改善，也不能把同时改变Qzz与Kd的结果归因于其中一个参数。

conclusion_zh.summary: 公共配置已修改为运动Kp45/45/65、Kd1，NMPC高度Qzz2000；9次测试中4次完成动作与30s站立，3次进一步满足无物理步请求力矩保护阈值事件和脚本跟踪检查。左右侧移仍不能重复稳定，后退高度偏低仍存在。
conclusion_zh.forward05: 完成20s运动+30s站立，末2s实际vx+.566517m/s、高度均值.332921m。运动15.823s发生RRthigh请求26.214Nm越过26.07门限，但未被500Hz SafetyMonitor捕获为FAULT。
conclusion_zh.backward05: 完成20s运动+30s站立，无WARN/FAULT；末2s实际vx-.490028m/s，高度均值.317724m，较.34目标低22.276mm。
conclusion_zh.left03: r1运动7.684s退出力矩保护；r2完成20s+30s，无WARN/FAULT，末2s vy+.328020m/s、高度均值.328652m。一失败一通过均保留，不能认定可重复稳定。
conclusion_zh.right03: r1/r2运动分别10.696s/8.994s退出，日志先RRhip力矩保护、后高度跌至.309m；不能以脚本最终报高度失败否定先前Safety事件。
conclusion_zh.yaw15: 双向±1.5rad/s各20s+30s站立，无WARN/FAULT；末2s实际+1.427363/-1.417710rad/s，高度均值约.331m。
conclusion_zh.interpretation: 合并参数没有解决横向保护和后退机身高度偏差；与旧方案不同测试时长/小样本不支持统计优势或唯一根因。当前保留用户要求参数，但不能作为真机高速运动验收。
